card.name: Start of dosing instructions in label headings
card.fires_on: Words that begin a dosing or administration instruction right after a section heading or sentence break, such as Pre (medication), Recommended, Do not, or Treatment. Also fires on spaces and partway through drug names in highlights text.

modes.label: Pre-medication heading
modes.description: The word Pre starting pre-medication or pre-medicate right after a dosage heading.

modes.label: Opening of an instruction
modes.description: The first word of a dosing sentence after a subheading, such as Recommended, Do not, or Treatment.
modes.example: Early Breast Cancer<< Recommended>> starting dose: 400 mg

modes.label: Inside names and reference numbers
modes.description: Partway through a drug name or a gap before section numbers in the highlights summary.

card.writes: It lowers tolerability and safety words, so the text after it is less likely to turn to how well the drug is tolerated.
card.plain: It marks the point where a label begins giving dosing or administration directions.
